name: The Iron Bastion of the Eastern Arm
flavor: Storm the giant-cut sea fortress and spike the siege battery before its cannons reduce Azure to kindling.

phases.narration: You vault from your lagoon skiff onto the slick granite causeway of the Eastern Arm. Ahead, the giant-hewn barbican looms against the bruised twilight sky, its battlements bristling with Redwake corsairs rallying behind a roaring brass war-horn.

You kick open the waterlogged oak doors into the fortress casemates. Knee-deep lagoon water sloshes through the vaulted armory where drowned powder-haulers haul munitions under the sinister incantations of a tide-witch.

You fight your way onto the wind-whipped upper battery. Enormous dwarf-forged siege cannons point directly across the open water toward Azure's vulnerable lagoon markets, commanded by Commodore Kallisto himself.
